core_phrases.irish: Ba mhaith liom é seo, le do thoil.
core_phrases.pronunciation_tip: Bah why lum ay shuh, leh duh hull.

core_phrases.irish: An féidir liom é a fháil sa mheánseo?
core_phrases.english: Can I get it in the medium size?
core_phrases.pronunciation_tip: On fay-dir lum ay ah awl sah vayn-shuh?

grammar_rule.title: Using 'An bhfuil' for questions
grammar_rule.explanation: In Irish, 'An bhfuil' is used to form yes/no questions. It literally means 'Is there'.
examples: An bhfuil tú ag iarraidh é?
An bhfuil sé sin sa mheánseo?

pronunciation_notes: Remember to stress the first syllable in 'éadaí' and 'bróga'.

mini_task.instruction: Imagine you are in a shop. Ask the shopkeeper 3 questions about different items.
prompts: Ask about the price of a scarf.
Inquire if the shoes are on sale.
